d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan joron par hain. shadi men bharat hi nahin, pakistan se bhi mehmanon ko nyota bhejne ki bat anant sinh ne kahi hai.
Unhonne bataya ki unke jitne dost aur shubhchintak hain, sabhi ko shadi ka kard bheja ja raha hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
